subject.title: fix: require admin for keyed session model changes [AI]

question: Should existing write-scoped Gateway clients be intentionally failed closed when `sessions.create` would reconfigure the model or thinking selection of an adopted keyed session?
rationale: The implementation and proof support the narrow authorization boundary, but only gateway/security owners can decide whether the upgrade-time loss of that previously permitted write path is the intended public operator contract.

options.title: Confirm admin-only reconfiguration
options.body: Keep this narrow handler/service gate and document that changed selection on an existing keyed session requires `operator.admin`.

options.title: Retain write compatibility temporarily
options.body: Do not land the fail-closed change until owners define a separately authorized compatibility path that does not leave model selection mutable through ordinary write scope.

recommendation.title: Confirm admin-only reconfiguration
recommendation.body: Keep this narrow handler/service gate and document that changed selection on an existing keyed session requires `operator.admin`.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a core Gateway authorization and compatibility policy decision.
